relationships.title: RE Truman Swain et al. v. Eastern Carolina Presbytery

occurrences.excerpt: …Carolina, i.e. that the complainants did not appear and therefore according to BCO 42-10 the case is judged to have been abandoned. The Commission had met several times, these meetings being duly announced. Adopted.

metadata.synopsis: A session's complaint against Eastern Carolina Presbytery for lifting from the table a matter concerning the church was abandoned because neither the complainant nor counsel appeared before the Commission within two days, despite public notice and a recess, and no satisfactory explanation was given. The Commission also confirmed and adopted the SCJB's interim advice on Reference 8: six questions were properly declined as redressable by complaint or review and control, while the seventh only required referring the applicant to the BCO.
